guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 從分流連續到回水與下游影響的分洪道分析。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Floodway analysis from flow division to backwater and downstream effects. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游Qin=400 m³/s、分洪Qb=120 m³/s，主河道Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s，分流比30%。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堰式Q=C bH^1.5，C=1.70 m^0.5/s、寬b=10 m、堰上水頭H=1.0 m，分流Q=17.0 m³/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設b=20 m、y=2 m、n=0.030 s/m^(1/3)、Sf=0.0004；A=40 m²、R=40/24 m，Q=AR^(2/3)√Sf/n=37.49 m³/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單寬流量q=5.0 m²/s、g=9.81 m/s²，臨界水深yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游v1=1.0 m/s、縮口v2=3.0 m/s、g=9.81 m/s²，動能水頭增量Δhv=(v2²−v1²)/(2g)=0.4077 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設S0=0.001、Sf=0.0005、Fr=0.60，dy/dx=(S0−Sf)/(1−Fr²)=0.00078125 m/m。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream Qin=400 m³/s and bypass Qb=120 m³/s. Main-channel Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s, with a 30% diversion fraction.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume weir Q=C bH^1.5, C=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=10 m and crest head H=1.0 m. Diversion Q=17.0 m³/s.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume b=20 m, y=2 m, n=0.030 s/m^(1/3), Sf=0.0004, A=40 m² and R=40/24 m. Manning Q=37.49 m³/s.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume unit discharge q=5.0 m²/s and g=9.81 m/s². Critical depth yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream v1=1.0 m/s, contracted v2=3.0 m/s and g=9.81 m/s². Kinetic-head increase Δhv=(v2²−v1²)/(2g)=0.4077 m.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume S0=0.001, Sf=0.0005 and Fr=0.60. Local depth gradient dy/dx=(S0−Sf)/(1−Fr²)=0.00078125 m/m.
timeline: 1962–1968　紅河原分洪道施工，形成城市外繞排洪路徑。
2006　元朗排洪繞道完成，連結分洪與河道生態配置。
2017　環保署發布水理參考手冊，提供流量控制演算背景。
timelineEn: 1962–1968 — Original Red River Floodway construction creates a bypass route around the city.
2006 — Yuen Long Bypass Floodway is completed with diversion and ecological elements.
2017 — EPA publishes its hydraulic reference manual supporting control and routing methods.
codes: 香港雨水排放手冊第五版：河渠及分洪整合
環保署雨洪模型水理參考：非恆定與控制構造
codesEn: Hong Kong Stormwater Drainage Manual fifth edition: channel and diversion integration
EPA SWMM hydraulic reference: unsteady routing and control structures
landmarksEn: Hong Kong Yuen Long Bypass Floodway
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：河道分洪工程
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: River flood-diversion works
guides.concept: 課程把分洪入口、渠段、收縮、尾水及重匯流視為同一系統，逐步計算流量、比能、臨界水深、波速與泥砂收支，再檢查高程餘量及數值解析度。紅河與元朗是已核對的實際工程背景，所有算例均為原創假設，並非這兩處的操作門檻或斷面設計。
guides.conceptEn: The course treats inlet, channel, contraction, tailwater and rejoining reach as one system, calculating discharge, specific energy, critical depth, wave speed and sediment budgets before checking elevation margins and numerical resolution. Red River and Yuen Long are verified project contexts. All numerical examples are original assumptions rather than their operating thresholds or section designs.
procedure: 分洪道把部分洪水移至另一條路徑，並沒有消除水量，因此必須同時描述主河道、分洪道和重新匯流的受益與負擔。局部水位降低可能伴隨上游回水或出口負荷增加，跨區影響不能藏在模型邊界外；分流比例是水位、構造物和支路阻力共同求得的結果，而不是永遠固定的設計百分比。本例只作瞬時水量連續，假設分流節點沒有蓄水或其他支路；不由此推定任何河段水位或可接受的影響分配。
分洪入口門檻使低水位時流量留在主河，水位超過門檻後才逐漸啟動支路。堰頂以上水頭的非線性關係，使小幅高程誤差可能明顯改變開始分流的時間與比例；實際側向入口、閘門和回水會偏離簡單正面堰，因此計算式應與入口構型一致。本例為理想正面自由矩形堰並指定係數，不描述紅河或元朗實際入口；不將此算式用作現場閘門操作規則。
分洪道的能力不只取決於寬度，水深、濕周、糙率和能量坡降都會改變輸水量。曼寧式適合穩定均勻流的初步尺度，但入口、橋梁、出口與潮汐回水通常需要非均勻流分析；將地形坡度不加檢查地當成能坡，可能高估平緩河段可提供的驅動水頭。本例為矩形固定斷面且採國際單位的曼寧式，所得不是整條分洪道的保證容量；最窄控制段與回水仍須另算。
明渠比能在指定單寬流量下存在最小值，對應臨界水深，縮窄或抬高底床可能把流況推向控制。臨界條件不等於正常水深，也不直接指出上游水面高程；判斷入口或橋孔是否壅水時，還須比較可用能量、局部損失與兩側邊界，不能只靠水深大小分類。本例為寬度固定的矩形渠、靜水壓分布且動能修正係數取一；複合斷面或強三維入口需其他求解。
分洪入口或橋孔縮窄會提高速度，部分水面位能轉為動能，另外還有不可回復的局部損失。速度水頭增加本身不是摩阻損失，把兩者重複扣除會錯算水面；反之若完全忽略損失，則可能高估可通流量，需要用一致能量線分開表達可逆轉換與耗散。本例只比較動能水頭、兩截面動能修正係數均取一；沒有假定相同底床或已求得水面差，也未包含局部損失。
緩流分洪道的下游水位可向上游影響水深，因此出口河川漲水可能降低分洪效益。漸變流方程把底坡、摩阻坡與福祿數連到局部水深梯度，但接近臨界時分母變小，局部線性外推會不可靠；閘門、跌水和水躍還需另處理，不能跨越不連續流況套同一坡度。本例為稜柱渠的局部漸變流導數，正座標沿下游，水深變化不等於絕對水面高程變化；不作長距離定坡外推。
洪峰訊號的傳遞速度不等於某一水團的移動速度，波速取決於流量隨儲水或水深的變化。對寬矩形均勻曼寧流的運動波近似，可得到流速的特定倍數，但回水、擴散與洪泛區儲存會破壞這個簡化；以距離除平均流速直接估警戒時間可能混淆兩種傳遞。本例採寬矩形、固定坡降與糙率的運動波關係c=5V/3，不用於強回水、閘控或急變洪水；不是實際預警提前量。
分洪道兩側堤頂到水面的幾何差只是起點，沉陷、波浪、模型不確定度與局部水位抬升都會消耗可用餘量。各項預留需要一致定義，不能重複扣已包含在設計水位中的因素；同一標準餘高也不能代替滲流、邊坡和出口安全分析，因為未越頂仍可能發生其他失效。本例只扣指定沉陷量，未加入波浪或其他必要項，也不是任何規範的所需餘高；輸入皆採相同高程基準。
分洪改變水量分配也會改變輸砂，進入支路的粒徑與濃度不一定和主河平均相同。長期淤積可能抬高入口或減少渠容，沖刷則可能威脅基礎；泥砂體積帳需要區分固體體積與含孔隙床體積，不能把水量分流比例直接當成泥砂分流比例。本例採均勻床面變化、固定孔隙率與固體體積輸砂率，只表示區段平均沉積；未預測局部沖刷或粒徑分選。
洪水演算需解析波在網格間的傳遞，時間步過大可能造成振盪、數值擴散或漏失短時控制。庫朗數可作顯式淺水波離散的尺度檢查，但不同求解器的穩定與準確條件不同，不能把一個數值當所有軟體保證；網格、時間步和邊界敏感度應與量測驗證一同檢查。本例使用矩形水深的重力波速與順流速度相加，指定目標庫朗數只為示範；隱式求解器或其他格式需依自身文件判斷。
procedureEn: A floodway transfers water to another route rather than eliminating it, requiring assessment of the main channel, bypass and rejoining reach. Local stage reduction may accompany upstream backwater or greater outlet loading, and transferred effects must not be hidden outside model boundaries. Diversion fraction emerges from levels, structures and branch resistance rather than remaining a fixed design percentage. The example applies instantaneous continuity without junction storage or other branches. It determines neither reach stages nor an acceptable distribution of impacts.

An inlet sill retains low flows in the main river and progressively activates the bypass as stage rises. Nonlinear dependence on head above crest means small elevation errors can alter diversion timing and share. Real lateral entrances, gates and backwater differ from a simple frontal weir, so the chosen relation must match the actual inlet configuration. The example is an ideal frontal free rectangular weir with a specified coefficient, not the actual Red River or Yuen Long inlet and not a field gate rule.

Floodway capacity depends on depth, wetted perimeter, roughness and energy slope as well as width. Manning’s equation gives a steady-uniform preliminary scale, while entrances, bridges, outlets and tidal backwater generally need nonuniform analysis. Substituting bed slope for energy slope without checking can overstate the driving head available in a flat reach. The example uses a fixed rectangular section and SI Manning form. It is not guaranteed capacity of the whole floodway; constrictions and backwater require separate analysis.

For a specified unit discharge, open-channel specific energy has a minimum at critical depth. Contraction or bed raising can drive a section toward control. Critical depth differs from normal depth and does not directly give upstream elevation; assessing choking also requires available energy, local losses and both boundaries rather than classifying flow from depth alone. The example assumes a fixed-width rectangular channel, hydrostatic pressure and unit energy coefficient. Compound sections or strongly three-dimensional entrances require another solution.

A contracted inlet or bridge opening accelerates flow, converting some surface potential into kinetic energy while also causing irreversible local losses. Increased velocity head is not itself friction loss, and deducting it twice miscalculates the surface. Ignoring actual loss has the opposite problem, so one energy line must distinguish reversible conversion from dissipation. The example compares kinetic heads with unit energy coefficients only. It does not assume equal bed elevations or determine surface difference, and it excludes local loss.

Downstream stage influences upstream depth in subcritical flow, so rising receiving water can reduce diversion benefit. The gradually varied equation relates bed slope, friction slope and Froude number to local depth gradient. Near critical conditions its denominator becomes small and linear extrapolation becomes unreliable; gates, drops and jumps also need separate treatment rather than one continuous slope. The example is a local gradually varied derivative in a prismatic channel with downstream-positive coordinate. Depth change is not absolute water-surface elevation change, and the slope is not extrapolated over a long reach.

A flood signal does not travel at the same speed as a water parcel; wave celerity depends on how discharge changes with storage or depth. A wide rectangular uniform Manning channel yields a particular velocity multiple under a kinematic approximation, but backwater, diffusion and floodplain storage break that simplification. Distance divided by mean velocity can therefore confuse parcel and warning travel times. The example uses c=5V/3 for a wide rectangular kinematic Manning channel with fixed slope and roughness, excluding strong backwater, gate control and abrupt flood transitions. It is not an operational warning lead time.

The geometric difference between crest and water surface is only a starting point. Settlement, waves, model uncertainty and local setup consume available margin. Allowances need consistent definitions to avoid deducting factors already included in design stage. A crest margin also does not replace seepage, slope or outlet analysis, because failure can occur without overtopping. The example deducts specified settlement only, omitting waves and other necessary terms. It is not a code-required freeboard, and all elevations use one datum.

Diverting water also redistributes sediment, whose size and concentration entering a branch may differ from the main-river average. Aggradation can raise the inlet or reduce channel space, while scour threatens foundations. A sediment-volume ledger distinguishes solids from porous bed volume and must not equate water diversion fraction with sediment diversion fraction. The example assumes uniform bed change, fixed porosity and solid-volume transport rates. It gives reach-average deposition only, excluding local scour and size sorting.

Flood routing must resolve propagation between cells; a large time step can cause oscillation, numerical diffusion or missed brief control. Courant number offers a scale check for explicit shallow-water discretization, but stability and accuracy differ among solvers. One number is not a universal software guarantee; grid, time-step and boundary sensitivity require checking alongside observations. The example adds rectangular-channel gravity-wave speed to downstream velocity for an illustrative target Courant number. Implicit solvers and other schemes require their own documented criteria.
evidence: 畫出含重新匯流點的完整控制體，標記每股流量和可能儲水區。說明缺少哪個邊界會讓局部效益被誤認為全流域效益，再檢查合成水量帳。
畫出正面與側向入口的差異，為同一指定水頭先做理想計算。再列出側向流、淹沒與閘門會新增的資料需求，避免把手算結果當實際分流量。
固定水深和坡降，把糙率提高兩成重算流量，再指出這不是定流量時的水位變化。將入口、橋梁和出口畫成控制鏈，辨認可能先限制能力的位置。
畫出指定單寬流量的比能曲線，標示可能的兩個水深分支。加入一個底床抬升情境，說明還需要哪些能量資料才能判斷是否發生控制。
建立含底高、水深、速度水頭與損失的能量帳，將已知和未知項分開。用兩種假設損失係數比較可用能量，說明速度變化無法單獨決定水面差。
evidenceEn: Draw a complete control volume including the rejoining point, labeling flows and possible storage. Identify a missing boundary that could turn a local benefit into a misleading basin-wide claim, then reconcile the synthetic ledger.

Draw frontal and lateral inlet differences and perform the ideal calculation at one specified head. List additional information for lateral approach, submergence and gates so that the hand result is not mistaken for actual diversion.

At fixed depth and slope increase roughness by twenty percent and recompute flow, noting that this is not the stage response at fixed discharge. Map inlet, bridge and outlet controls to identify possible governing restrictions.
Plot specific energy for the given unit discharge and mark the two possible depth branches. Introduce a bed rise and identify the energy information still needed to decide whether choking occurs.

Build an energy ledger with bed elevation, depth, kinetic head and loss, separating knowns from unknowns. Compare available energy under two assumed loss coefficients and explain why velocity change alone cannot determine surface difference.
pitfalls: 只展示城市段降水位會漏掉其他地區的負擔，將分流比例固定則可能忽略尾水和入口控制；水量帳不閉合時，模型可能把外排錯當成消失的洪水。
只加寬一段而不處理下游控制可能幾乎不增加整體能力，季節植被也會改變有效糙率；若模型仍用清潔新渠值，長期排洪能力會被高估。
把所有水面下降當成能量耗散會混淆加速與損失，模型校正可能因此選錯係數；漏掉局部損失又會使收縮控制過於樂觀，兩者都會影響上游壅水預測。
把水團行程當洪峰行程可能錯估訊號到達時間，忽略洪泛區儲存則可能漏掉展寬；若再把遙測延遲算進物理波速，模型參數會失去明確意義。
漏掉孔隙率會低估沉積床體積，區段平均很小也可能掩蓋入口沙洲；固定河床模型若用於多年規劃，可能高估未來分洪能力或漏掉局部基礎沖刷。
pitfallsEn: Showing only reduced city stage omits burdens elsewhere, while a fixed split can ignore tailwater and inlet control. An unclosed ledger may treat transferred water as flood volume that has disappeared.

Widening one reach without addressing downstream control may barely improve overall capacity. Seasonal vegetation changes effective roughness, and continued use of a clean new-channel value can overstate long-term conveyance.

Calling every surface drop dissipation confuses acceleration with loss and can lead calibration to the wrong coefficient. Omitting local losses makes contraction control optimistic; both errors affect predicted upstream backwater.

Using parcel travel for crest travel misstates arrival, while omitting floodplain storage misses broadening. Folding telemetry delay into physical celerity additionally gives model parameters an ambiguous and misleading meaning.

Omitting porosity understates deposited bed volume, and a small reach average can conceal an inlet bar. A fixed-bed model used for long-term planning may overstate future diversion or miss local foundation scour.

related.title: 都市滯洪池配置
related.transfer: 可遷移「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」與「洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；都市滯洪池配置的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification" and "Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Urban detention-basin planning must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從分流連續到回水與下游影響的分洪道分析；都市滯洪池配置則以以事件體積、出流時間與下游條件配置都市滯洪為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on floodway analysis from flow division to backwater and downstream effects; Urban detention-basin planning centres on planning urban detention through event volume release timing and downstream conditions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「分流控制體與受益範圍」與「集水區與逕流體積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到都市滯洪池配置，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「變水頭排空時間機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Diversion control volume and effects” and “Catchment and runoff volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Urban detention-basin planning, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Drawdown under changing head mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.title: 河道分洪工程
history.text: 紅河原分洪道於1962至1968年興建，曼尼托巴官方資料說明低水位時入口門檻和洪水時主河與繞道互動；擴建投資於2005年開始。元朗排洪繞道於2003年開工、2006年完成，把部分逕流帶到錦田河下游，並結合濕地與低流量管理。環保署2017年水理手冊提供管渠、控制構造和演算方法背景。本課僅借用已核對的歷史與功能，未宣稱兩處工程採用所列理想堰或假設糙率。
history.textEn: The original Red River Floodway was constructed from 1962 to 1968; Manitoba describes the low-stage inlet threshold and interaction of river and bypass during floods, with expansion investment beginning in 2005. Yuen Long began construction in 2003 and was completed in 2006, diverting part of runoff toward lower Kam Tin while integrating wetland and low-flow management. EPA’s 2017 hydraulic manual supplies routing and control-method context. Only verified history and function are used; neither project is claimed to employ the lesson’s ideal weir or assumed roughness.
